episodes.title: Set Yourself on Fire
episodes.summary: Alvey's son Nate trains for a fight that could determine the future of Navy Street; Alvey's other son Jay clashes with his father; Lisa's ex-flame Ryan, a former MMA fighter, returns unexpectedly.

episodes.title: Glass Eye
episodes.summary: Lisa gets real about finances; Alvey sticks by his plan for Ryan; Ryan settles into the halfway house; Jay longs to fight again; Alvey demands more commitment from Jay.

episodes.title: Piece of Plastic
episodes.summary: Ryan starts a new job alongside other ex-cons; Alvey consults with Ryan's parole officer; Physical therapy challenges Nate; Michael harasses Keith; Ryan delves into Keith's past; Jay comes to Christina's rescue.

episodes.title: Flowers
episodes.summary: Christina clashes with Jay over her plans for a new life; potential investors put Jay on edge; Lisa plans to help Jay; Nate discusses his case with Detective Gaines.

episodes.title: Eat Your Own Cooking
episodes.summary: Alvey doubts his self-control while pining for revenge; Lisa's father Ron arrives for a visit; Nate finds romance; "Family Day" proves a lonely ordeal for Keith and Ryan; Lisa ponders forgiveness.

episodes.title: Please Refrain from Crying
episodes.summary: Ryan pleads with his father for forgiveness; Michael bullies Keith; Christina spends time with Nate, and opens up to him about her youth.

episodes.title: Animator / Annihilator
episodes.summary: Tensions run high between Lisa and Alvey after Christina shows up at Navy St. Garo tries to find out how Ryan's training is coming along. Jay, building off the recent win, asks Garo to give him a chance. Christina wrestles with her emotions.

episodes.title: The Gentle Slope
episodes.summary: Ryan and Alvey are in the spotlight at the King Beast promotional event. Alvey counsels Christina on getting professional help for her addiction. Lisa sees a lawyer looking for advice. Jay searches for Hector & Carlos.

episodes.title: Cut Day
episodes.summary: It's cut day for Ryan and Jay. With the weigh-in only hours away, the two struggle through the agony of cutting weight while Lisa tries to reach Alvey. Nate, determined to get back into the ring quickly, asks Mac for help.

episodes.title: King Beast
episodes.summary: Fight night for Jay and Ryan; Alvey and Lisa put their quarrel on hold; Lisa doubts herself; Christina's demons return.

episodes.title: New Money
episodes.summary: Ryan contends with illness on the day of his title defense, Jay's opponent presents him with an unexpected challenge, and Lisa recruits a new fighter. Alvey oversees it all while opening up a new gym.

episodes.title: Simulations
episodes.summary: Alvey deals with Ryan's reckless decisions and Lisa introduces her newest fighter, Alicia, to Navy St. Nate gears up for his return to the cage. Jay meets a photographer, Laura, who presents professional and personal opportunities.

episodes.title: Broken or Missing
episodes.summary: Keith is released from jail and moves back in with Ryan, Jay is given an intriguing offer by Garo, and Nate has his first fight back since he was brutally assaulted.

episodes.title: Be First
episodes.summary: Nate finds his problems compounded after his loss and Jay spins out of control in his pursuit of Laura. Lisa explores what her future will look like when her baby arrives.

episodes.title: Happy Hour
episodes.summary: Ryan heads to his dad's house to check on him, where a new relationship seems possible. Jay agrees to Alvey's plan for a new direction and Nate eyes a quick return to the cage.

episodes.title: Pink at Night
episodes.summary: Jay tracks down his competition for Laura, while Christina eyes a career change. Lisa cuts a deal with Garo, presenting Jay with an unexpected opportunity

episodes.title: The Demon Had a Spell
episodes.summary: Alvey and Nate head off to a low-rent fight in Fresno, Jay grows feral as he deals with his weight cut and breakup with Laura, and Lisa hatches a plan to resurrect Ryan's image.

episodes.title: Smoker
episodes.summary: Alvey and Lisa open Navy St. up for a showcase, inviting sponsors into the gym to see Alicia in action. Ryan and Jay, knowing this could be their last opportunity to evade Alvey's attention, enjoy a cheat day.

episodes.title: Living Down
episodes.summary: Christina searches for new living arrangements, Lisa realizes Alvey's home may not be the place for her, and Ryan and Jay cut weight as their respective title fights loom.

episodes.title: Traveling Alone
episodes.summary: Ryan defends his lightweight title, while Nate and Jay discover Christina in a bad spot. Alvey gets a call from an old friend, and Lisa makes a final decision regarding her future.

episodes.title: Lay and Pray
episodes.summary: As Jay and Ryan promote their upcoming championship bout, Alvey is on the receiving end of tragic news. But all attention shifts to Alicia as she preps for her first professional fight as a member of Navy St.

episodes.title: No Fault
episodes.summary: The arrival of a family member surprises Alicia; Ryan sees a doctor after his drunken brawl; and Nate takes a job with unexpected demands.

episodes.title: Woke Up Lonely
episodes.summary: The day of Jay and Ryan's fight finds everyone taking on new roles: Nate corners for Jay; Alicia and Ava host the afterparty; and Alvey takes a breather. Of course, before that can happen, Ryan has to decide whether he's ready to fight.

episodes.title: Do Not Disturb
episodes.summary: Alvey believes that an offer Alicia received is better than it is; Jay and Ava celebrate his championship; and Alvey makes amends for a past accident.

episodes.title: Take Pills
episodes.summary: An unexpected visitor upends Jay and Ava's plans; Ryan breaks up Alicia's living situation; and questions surface about why Ryan lost the championship fight.

episodes.title: Halos
episodes.summary: Nate looks to end his losing streak and prove that he's still a viable fighter; and Mac brings something into Navy St. that threatens the gym's operations.

episodes.title: Help Wanted
episodes.summary: Lisa returns to Los Angeles; Ryan demonstrates his dominance of the gym; and Nate tries to lure Jay away from his new life with Ava.

episodes.title: Cut Man
episodes.summary: A fight could change Alicia's career; and Lisa's return impacts Alvey's relationship with Roxanne.

episodes.title: Late to Leave
episodes.summary: Alicia makes a major career decision; and Ryan is reminded of just how unstable his roommate is.

episodes.title: No Sharp Objects
episodes.summary: Jay's rematch with Ryan comes at a bad time for Jay; and Alvey helps an old friend.

episodes.title: Wolf Tickets
episodes.summary: Nate looks to prove himself in the cage; Ryan defends his title; Jay seeks balance in his new life; and, with plans to take King Beast to the next level, Garo presents Alvey with a lucrative offer.

episodes.title: Ritual
episodes.summary: Lisa hires help at Navy St. so Alvey can focus on training; Jay struggles to adjust to working life; Garo tries to woo Ryan back to King Beast; Christina makes the best of a new situation; and Alvey forges a deeper bond with Nate.

episodes.title: Thank You, Boys
episodes.summary: While Alvey deals with a health scare, Lisa proves her worth as a manager; a gift from Ryan presents complications for Jay and Amy; Jay takes Ryan on a real-estate tour; and Lisa goes on a date.

episodes.title: Headhunter
episodes.summary: Dom's relationship with Ryan creates problems with Alvey and Lisa; Nate tries to make peace when Jay causes tension at home; and Alvey gets a surprise from his past.

episodes.title: Please Give
episodes.summary: Dom pushes boundaries at the gym; Christina takes charge of Kayla and the girls; Jay continues to struggle with Amy and work; Lisa gets Nate a fight on short notice; and Ryan takes a break from training.

episodes.title: All Talk
episodes.summary: Ryan deals with the consequences of his actions; Nate helps Alvey with press for his fight; Dom gets closer to Ryan; Jay and Mac look for a party; and Nate takes on a tough opponent.

episodes.title: Platinum Level
episodes.summary: Ryan checks in with Keith; Alvey looks for a distraction from his pain; a new boss moves in with Christina; Jay gets back in the gym; and Lisa considers a tempting offer.

episodes.title: Old Pueblo
episodes.summary: An unexpected trip makes Alvey reassess his relationship with his sons; Cody puts Christina in a tough position with Kayla; Ryan questions Lisa's judgment about Dom; and Lisa makes a decision.

episodes.title: Cactus
episodes.summary: Dom dishes on Navy St. and forces Lisa to make an unexpected move; and Alvey tries to connect with his mother while bonding with Nate and Jay in the desert.

episodes.title: Lie Down in the Light
episodes.summary: Alvey's comeback fight couldn't come at a worse time as Navy St. comes to grips with tragedy. Roles are reversed when Ryan coaches Alvey, and Lisa begins a new chapter.
